fields.title: 📖 Be among the children of the Ākhirah
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib** رضي الله عنه said:

***“The Dunyā has departed and turned away, and the Ākhirah has come forward and drawn near. Each of the two has children. So be among the children of the Ākhirah and do not be among the children of the Dunyā. For today there are deeds and no reckoning; and tomorrow there is reckoning and no deeds.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The Dunyā calls to distraction, the Ākhirah calls to preparation. Whoever is wise uses the day of action before the day of reckoning comes.

immutable.source: 📝 Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, az-Zuhd, Zuhd ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, S. 108, Nr. 693
